cases.query: 参与 LS 系列评审组的项目中，有哪些来自西班牙的机构？
cases.golden_sql: SELECT DISTINCT i.institutions_name FROM institutions i JOIN project_members pm ON pm.institution_id = i.unics_id JOIN projects p ON p.unics_id = pm.project JOIN project_erc_panels pep ON pep.project = p.unics_id JOIN erc_panels ep ON ep.code = pep.panel JOIN countries c ON c.unics_id = i.country_id WHERE ep.code LIKE 'LS%' AND c.country_name = 'Spain' ORDER BY 1
cases.expected_ontology: 关系链 Project↔ErcPanel/Institution/Country 串联 6 表；成员角色与国家经值字典定位
cases.expected_baseline_gap: ReAct 基线需在 6 表间自行发现 5 条 JOIN 路径

cases.query: 缩写为 0MSPIN 的项目的基本信息与参与机构有哪些？
cases.golden_sql: SELECT p.acronym, p.title, p.start_date, p.total_cost, i.institutions_name FROM projects p LEFT JOIN project_members pm ON pm.project = p.unics_id LEFT JOIN institutions i ON i.unics_id = pm.institution_id WHERE p.acronym = '0MSPIN' ORDER BY 4 DESC
cases.expected_ontology: 值字典 matchedValue 精确定位 acronym→projects；titleProperties 透出输出列
cases.expected_baseline_gap: 基线靠 LIKE 猜列/全表扫 acronym

cases.query: 名称包含 Solvay 的机构参与了哪些项目？
cases.golden_sql: SELECT DISTINCT p.acronym, p.title FROM institutions i JOIN project_members pm ON pm.institution_id = i.unics_id JOIN projects p ON p.unics_id = pm.project WHERE i.institutions_name ILIKE '%Solvay%' ORDER BY 1
cases.expected_ontology: 值字典未命中（institutions_name 未登记）→ isTitle 受控模糊 degraded 如实标注
cases.expected_baseline_gap: 基线同样可行 → 预期持平（边界如实 case）

cases.query: 有哪些项目同时参与了 FETOPEN-1-2014 和 FETOPEN-RIA-2014-2015 两个资助主题？
cases.golden_sql: SELECT p.acronym FROM projects p JOIN project_topics pt1 ON pt1.project = p.unics_id AND lower(pt1.topic) = 'fetopen-1-2014' JOIN project_topics pt2 ON pt2.project = p.unics_id AND lower(pt2.topic) = 'fetopen-ria-2014-2015' ORDER BY 1
cases.expected_ontology: REVIEWED_BY_PANEL viaTable（project_erc_panels）两腿 JOIN + 双主题交集模式直接给出
cases.expected_baseline_gap: 基线需自行发现中间表与双重 JOIN 交集模式

cases.query: 各框架计划下分别有多少个不同的项目？
cases.golden_sql: SELECT p.framework_program, COUNT(DISTINCT p.unics_id) AS project_count FROM projects p WHERE p.framework_program IS NOT NULL GROUP BY p.framework_program ORDER BY 2 DESC
cases.expected_ontology: 列级聚合口径（DISTINCT）由列语义引导；与指标登记完全解耦（FR-018）
cases.expected_baseline_gap: 基线可完成 → 预期持平或本体略优（口径清晰度）

cases.query: 参与机构数量最多的国家有哪些？（参与主体视角）
cases.golden_sql: SELECT c.country_name, COUNT(DISTINCT i.unics_id) AS institution_count FROM institutions i JOIN countries c ON c.unics_id = i.country_id GROUP BY c.country_name ORDER BY institution_count DESC LIMIT 5
cases.expected_ontology: 问句同时命中两视角同名实体（Institution/Country）→ 域投票消歧到 cordis_eval_org
cases.expected_baseline_gap: 基线无本体概念，跨视角同名实体无消歧机制 → 预期更差

cases.query: 按总费用从高到低列出前 5 个项目的缩写、标题和预算
cases.golden_sql: SELECT acronym, title, total_cost FROM projects WHERE acronym IS NOT NULL ORDER BY total_cost DESC LIMIT 5
cases.expected_ontology: Project 实体 titleProperties(acronym/title) + primaryProperties(total_cost) 直接映射 SELECT+ORDER BY
cases.expected_baseline_gap: 基线从列描述猜测含义，可能选错列

cases.query: 2018 年之后启动的项目中，担任协调方的成员机构按所在国家统计各有多少个？
cases.golden_sql: SELECT c.country_name, COUNT(DISTINCT i.unics_id) AS institution_count FROM projects p JOIN project_members pm ON pm.project = p.unics_id AND pm.member_role = 'coordinator' JOIN institutions i ON i.unics_id = pm.institution_id JOIN countries c ON c.unics_id = i.country_id WHERE p.start_date >= DATE '2018-01-01' GROUP BY c.country_name ORDER BY institution_count DESC
cases.expected_ontology: 复合覆盖维度⑤⑧：时间过滤 + member_role 值字典（coordinator）+ 跨实体聚合分组全链引导
cases.expected_baseline_gap: 基线需同时理解角色过滤（值字典）、时间过滤、4 表 JOIN 与 GROUP BY
